notes: Fibre Channel does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept, but the 64-bit World Wide Names (WWNN/WWPN) are permanent, factory-assigned, globally unique identifiers — the functional equivalent of burned-in identity — exchanged at login (FLOGI/PLOGI) and used for naming, zoning, and authentication. The 24-bit FC address, by contrast, is assigned dynamically by the fabric at FLOGI, not burned in.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Globally unique 64-bit node name, burned in by the manufacturer (analogous to a MAC address).
Globally unique 64-bit port name used for naming, zoning, and authentication.
